One-X-account launches in this queue (hood turtle #364, grade C) historically stall on follow-through.
decisions.risks: (1) Byte-identical to the farm template - onchain indistinguishable from the 23 dead farm tokens in the same batch; verify CA against the @SpecsPad account before ever touching it. (2) Gate found NO V2 WETH pair and NO V4 pools - there is no liquidity venue, so nothing is actionable and LP-lock checks are skipped; durability of an unbuyable token is moot. (3) Engagement-bait reply pattern (@vladtenev/@coingecko 'We are coming Sir') is a cheap growth tactic typical of farm launches. (4) Anonymous team, no shipped product; the 'Ordinals on Pons' claim is unverifiable from this chain. (5) 13 transfers / 12 holders in ~9h - thin and not accelerating; the announcement landed 2026-10-09 20:07Z with no measurable follow-on. (6) Token launched ~1h BEFORE the announcement - consistent with real launch, equally consistent with a launcher pre-seeding before the post.

decisions.risks: sell leg unproven by history: gate notes no CurveSell events in 20k blocks (sell selector onchain-verified and executor forward-simulates at exit, but no lived sell flow yet; investigation itself records 3 sells, so early exit flow is thin); anonymous deployer 0x5a73fa9bfdcc1a414961b6f8545771d78ca18b23, nonce=1 (fresh, no delivery history on file); thin holder data (gate: 7 addresses in 12k-block window; investigation: 16 holders, 24 transfers) - very small base; no owner() so deployer undiscoverable via RPC and denylist check skipped; Solana pulse risk-off-leaning (SOL $107.75, -3.62% 24h) already tempered the verdict from promising to needs-snug; no social footprint yet.
decisions.reason: uncertain durability: pre-social P (found 2026-10-12T17:04:31Z, ~13 min old at breakdown, no matching entry in social-scores.json - judged onchain only, no social penalty, no tailwind). No affirmative bad evidence (no bot-farm, wash/prop, sniper dominance, fake socials, scam flag or toxic-name hit; deployer nonce 1 is fresh, not serial), so no hard skip applies. Real early velocity (0.1317 ETH curve in ~6.6 min, 1.4 buys/min, 9/9 distinct buyers, only 3 sells) argues against a skip, but an unproven sell history, tiny holder base, fresh anonymous deployer and the risk-off pulse argue against a buy; fast_lane no-buy/agent-veto also stands. Watch for graduation, lived sell flow and holder retention on a fresh recheck.

decisions.decision_note: score 34 <50 watch. real early velocity (0.1317 ETH curve, 1.4 buys/min, 9/9 distinct buyers, 3 sells) capped: vol/liq <1.5 so momentum capped 6, sell leg unproven, thin holders, fresh anon deployer, risk-off pulse, snug uncertain/watch, fast-lane no-buy stands. grade P, no affirmative bad evidence. recheck only on graduation/lived sells/holder retention.
